semiconductor_relevance: High — PM B.V. manufactures high-precision positioning systems and linear guides specifically for semiconductor equipment applications.
summary: PM B.V. is a Dutch manufacturer specializing in high-precision linear guides and customized positioning systems for the semiconductor industry. Their products are utilized in critical applications such as lithography, bonding, testing, and metrology, enhancing the performance of wafer inspection tools.
capabilities: XY2Z-Theta motion systems for wafer inspection
5-axis wafer inspection stages for optical and e-beam applications
Cross roller miniature linear slides with anti-cage creep technology
